scripts.check: ultracite check --deny-warnings && pnpm test:local && pnpm typecheck:local && pnpm build:local && pnpm service:check
scripts.service:web-build: pnpm --filter @lenso/console-module-api build && pnpm --filter @lenso/console-ui build && pnpm --filter @lenso/console-system-plane build && tsc -b && VITE_CONSOLE_MODE=api VITE_API_BASE_URL=/ vite build
